verdicts.reason: A has a strong headline and reads cleanly from left to right into the CTA, but the plan cards are shrunk to thumbnails, so their labels and 'per month' copy can't be read. The cards are also out of order (6, 80, 48), and the legal text is nearly as big as the subtitle and sits crammed against the right edge. B keeps the cards in order and the prices readable, but the cards are jammed against the top and bottom edges. Its headline is undersized, and the subtitle is split off to the left, so reading order is jumbled. The legal text is a tiny, illegible column wedged between the CTA and the cards.
